messages.en: What are you doing~
I had a bit of free time so I texted you.
The concert isn't far away anymore,
so I'm nervous.
With every concert,
I can definitely feel that I'm doing better than beforeㅎ.
I really want to show you that,
but things don't always go the way I want, so I feel anxious.
Still... once I get on stage, I'll do well, right??
I'll show you a cool performance.
Oh right, recently
I went to perform at a university event for the first time in a while.
When we did university events before,
it was always older students.
But now people my age were sitting there,
and it felt kind of strange.
Starting next year they'll all be younger than me... what do I do....
Don't say that...
If I hadn't debuted, I would've been sitting there too,
watching our members
"Wow, it's tripleS!!!!"
Maybe that's what I would've been sayingㅋㅋㅋㅋ
If that were your universe, what major would you have chosen?
Business administration, of courseㅋ.
Or maybe law?
I was going to go to Seoul National University,
but I yielded the spot to someone who'd do better than me.
That's allㅎ.

messages.ko: 그냥 학식 맛있는 학교 가실거 같은데
messages.en: I feel like you'd just choose a school with good cafeteria food though.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ That's the most important thing.

messages.ko: 안녕하세요 서울대 갈 뻔한 정하연입니다 ㅎㅎ
messages.en: Hello, this is Jeong Hayeon who almost went to Seoul National Universityㅎㅎ.
Oh, and I dyed my hair,
but no one noticed.
I purposely didn't say anything...
Before, it was a yellow-toned brown,
but now it's a red-mixed brown.
A slightly cherry color.
Hmph.
Try harder!
The weather today is seseseriously nice.
After work,
I'm going to see Faust.
"When do you get off work?"
I don't know.
I'll just run away by myself.
ㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
It's so tiring!!!!!!!
Save me.
But I still have to do it.
I need to show Faust a pretty stage..
Did the SNS post go up?
I look pretty right now..?
ㅎㅎㅎ

messages.ko: 근데 궁금한 게 sns 멘트는 하연이가 쓰는 거야?
messages.en: But I'm curious—does Hayeon write the SNS captions herself?
Yes.

messages.ko: 하연이 영어 명언 요즘에는 왜 안써줘ㅠ
messages.en: Then why don't you post English quotes these daysㅠ

messages.ko: 놀림 너무 당해서 쿨타임 차야 해
messages.en: I got teased too much. I need a cooldown period.
I'm curious about that too.
A few years ago you posted English phrases...
I searched really hard on Naver...

messages.ko: 근데 이제 네이버 말고 지피티한테 물어보려고!! 하하
messages.en: But now instead of Naver, I'm going to ask GPT!! Haha.
On Naver,
"Touching quotes,"
"Cool quotes,"
I'd search those
and look really hard to find good ones.
Now I'll just make GPT do it.

messages.ko: 진짜 어떡해 지금 회사에서 웃참못해서 화장실로 도망옴..
messages.en: What do I do? I couldn't hold in my laughter at work, so I ran to the bathroom..
Wouldn't it be scary if you laugh in the bathroom?
ㅌㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Looking for Hayeon to recommend dinner.
Oh right, all the members together
have been saying since yesterday that we want spring cabbage bibimbap.
So during practice today we said let's order it,
so they probably ordered it by now.
Spring cabbage bibimbap❤️
I ordered it too.
My algorithm only shows spring cabbage and soy sauce marinated crab.
I'm going crazy.
I'm going crazy over you…///
You're going crazy?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I have to go nowㅠ
I'm leaving the country soon.
First concert in Taipei, fighting~😍
Let's do our best today too.
Have a good day.
Haranghae🫶❤️‍🔥
